claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_lifecycle.becomes_nonmagical_on_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item surface can encode the passive attack and damage bonuses, but it cannot encode a successful-hit lifecycle that removes the item's magic while leaving the ammunition itself present.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: “Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.”
